Obtaining or entitled to a half, Man. 8, 239. नृप-मान-, Obtaining royal honour, Man. 2, 139. विभाग-, m. Entitled to a portion of a property already dis-tributed, as a son born after the distri-bution of his father's property. वियो-ग-, adj. Suffering separation, cf. also Pañc. i. d. 196; 147, 12.
भाजन: भाजन भाजन, भज् + अन, n.  1. Any vessel, as a pot or cup, Hit. pr. d. 8, M.M.; figuratively, Pañc. ii. d. 194 (a vessel of love and confidence, a person on whom one may depend).  2. A fit person.  3. Sharing.  -- Comp. दीप- n. a lamp, Daśak. in Chr. 186, 11.
भाजनत्व: भाजनत्व भाजन + त्व, n. Condi-tion of being a vessel, i. e. a fit object, Mālav. d. 83.
भाटक: भाटक भाटक, i. e. probably भट + क, m. Price, wages.
भाट्ट: भाट्ट भाट्ट, i. e. भट्ट + अ, m. A follower of Kumārila Bhaṭṭa, Vedān-tas. in Chr. 211, 9.
भाण्ड: भाण्ड भाण्ड, n.  1. Any vessel, a pot, a cup, Pañc. 96, 18; Hit. 85, 14.  2. Any implement or utensil, Sāv. 3, 1.  3. The capital, principal of a mer-chant.  4. Goods, wares, Pañc. 7, 17 (देश-अन्तर-भाण्ड-आनयन, n. Ex-porting wares to foreign countries), i. d. 19.  5. An ornament, Daśak. in Chr. 187, 2.  6. Any musical instru-ment, Man. 10, 49.  7. The bed of a river.  -- Comp. क्षुर-, n. a razor-case, Hit. 64, 20. भिन्न- (vb. भिद्), n. 1. a potsherd. 2. a broken vessel. महा-, n. a great vessel, Pañc. 62, 25. सार-, n. 1. a natural vessel, as the bag or skin in which musk is sold. 2. a bale of goods, Pañc. 8, 14. 3. im-plements, Mālav. 44, 1 (Prākṛ.)
भाण्डायन: भाण्डायन भाण्डायन, n. A pro-per name, Utt. Rāmac. 91, 8.
भाण्डिक: भाण्डिक भाण्डिक, i. e. भाण्ड + इक, m. A musician.
भाण्डिल: भाण्डिल भाण्डिल, i. e. भाण्ड + इल, m. A barber.
भातु: भातु भा + तु, m. The sun.
भाद्र: भाद्र भाद्र, i. e. भद्र + अ, m. The name of a month, August -- Sep-tember.
भाद्रमातुर: भाद्रमातुर भाद्रमातुर, i. e. भद्र-मातृ + अ, m. The son of a virtuous wife.
भान: भान भान, i. e. भा + अन, n.  1. Appearance, Vedāntas. in Chr. 217, 3.  2. Perception, Bhāṣāp. 65. -- Cf. ϕανός.
भानतस्: भानतस् भान + तस्, adv. In con-sequence of the appearance, Vedāntas. in Chr. 202, 5.
भानवत्: भानवन्त् भान + वन्त्, adj. En-dowed with the appearance, Vedāntas. in Chr. 217, 3.
भानवन्त्: भानवन्त् भान + वन्त्, adj. En-dowed with the appearance, Vedāntas. in Chr. 217, 3.
भानु: भानु भा + नु,  I. m.  1. A ray of light, Chr. 288, 9 = Rigv. i. 48, 9.  2. Light.  3. The sun, Pañc. 134, 17.  4. A sovereign, a master.  II. f. A handsome woman.  -- Comp. चित्र-,  I. adj. resplendent, Chr. 290, 7 = Rigv. i. 64, 7.  II. m. fire, MBh. 1, 2036. वृहद्-भानु, i. e. वृहन्त्-, m. a name of Agni. स्वर्-, m. Rāhu, the ascend-ing node, Chr. 36, 23.
भानुमत्: भानुमन्त् भानु + मन्त्, adj., f. मती।  1. Luminous, splendid.  2. Beau-tiful, Draup. 7, 2.
भानुमन्त्: भानुमन्त् भानु + मन्त्, adj., f. मती।  1. Luminous, splendid.  2. Beau-tiful, Draup. 7, 2.
भाम्: भाम् भाम् (rather a denomin. derived from भाम), i. 1, Ātm., and i. 10, Par. To be angry or wrathful.
भाम: भाम भा + म,  I. m.  1. Light.  2. The sun.  3. Passion, wrath.  4. A sister's husband.  II. f. मा। A pas-sionate woman. -- Cf. probably A.S. beam, a sun-beam, beamian, to shine (cf. the last).
भामिन्: भामिन् भामिन्, i. e. भाम + इन्,  I. adj., f. नी, Passionate, Ragh. 8, 28.  II. f. नी, A passionate woman, often used, as a term of endearment, in the same sense as मानिनी।
भार: भार भार, i. e. भृ + अ, m.  1. Carrying burthens, Pañc. i. d. 312.  2. Weight, a burthen, Pañc. 52, 4; figurat., Pañc. 31, 3 (of government); v. d. 4.  3. A great weight, Pañc. 99, 25.  4. A weight of gold equal to two thousand Palas.  5. A yoke.  -- Comp. अति-, m. 1. a too great burthen, Pañc. i. d. 22. 2. a proper name. काष्ठ-, m. a load of wood, Hariv. 4356. गर्भ-, m. the burthen of being with child, Kathās. 26, 216. अर्ह-, m. 1. the circumference of a peacock's tail, Megh. 102. 2. the tuft of a peacock's feathers at the shaft of a lance or the handle of a club.
भारक: भारक भार + क, m. A load, Man. 11, 133.
भारण्ड: भारण्ड भारण्ड, भारुण्ड भा-रुण्ड, भेरण्ड भेरण्ड (m.), The name of a fabulous bird, see Pañc. 263, 19; cf. my translation, 535, n. 1437. f. दी, Its female, Pañc. 264, 4.
भारत: भारत भारत, i. e. भरत + अ,  I. patronym. A descendant of Bharata, Hit. iv. d. 86.  II. m.  1. An actor.  2. A name of fire.  III. f. ती।  1. Speech, Chr. 53, 1.  2. Dramatic recitation.  3. The goddess of speech, Pañc. ii. d. 16.  4. A quail.  IV. n.  1. India proper.  2. A great epic poem, also महाभारत महा-, n.
भारद्वाज: भारद्वाज भारद्वाज, i. e. भरद्-वाज + अ,  I. patronym., m.  1. Epithet of Droṇa.  2. One of the seven Ṛṣis.  3. Agastya.  4. The son of Vṛhas-pati.  II. m. A skylark, Pañc. 157, Wild cotton.  IV. n. A bone.
भारवि: भारवि भारवि, m. The name of a poet, Chr. 170, 1.
भारिक: भारिक भारिक, i. e. भार + इक, m. A porter, Rājat. 5, 204 (treasurer; cf. 176 and my Chr. p. 315, n. ad 176.  I propose to read भौरिक).
भारिन्: भारिन् भारिन्, i. e. भार + इन्, m. A porter, Man. 2, 138; Kathās. 22, 96.
भार्गव: भार्गव भार्गव, i. e. भृगु + अ, patronym.  I. m.  1. A descendant of Bhṛgu.  2. Epithet of Paraśurāma, Johns. Sel. 4, 22; Utt. Rāmac. 13, 10.  3. A name of Śukra, regent of Venus.  4. An archer.  5. An elephant.  6. A proper name, Johns. Sel. 60, 189.  II. f. वी।  1. Pārvatī.  2. Lakṣmī.  3. Bent grass, Panicum dactylon.
भार्या: भार्या भार्या, properly ptcple. fut. pass. of भृ, f. A wife, Pañc. 137, 9.  -- Comp. कु-,  I. f. a wicked wife, Mārk. P. 21, 73.  II. कु-भार्य, adj. having a wicked wife, Bhāg. P. 6, 5, 15. स -भार्य, adj. with (his) wife, Rām. 3, 55, 42.
भार्याट: भार्याट भार्याट, m. A man who lets out his wife for prostitution.
भार्यात्व: भार्यात्व भार्या + त्व, f. State of a female, Man. 12, 69.
भाल: भाल भाल, m.  1. The forehead, Bhartṛ. 2, 48.  2. i. e. भा + ल, Lustre.
भालु: भालु भा + लु, m. The sun.
भालूक: भालूक भालूक, m. A bear (cf. भल्लक).
भाव: भाव भाव, i. e. भू + अ, m.  1. State, Hit. pr. d. 28, M.M.; Vikr. d. 115 (नदी -भावेन परिणत, changed into a river).  2. Property, Pañc. iv. d. 62; nature, Nal. 10, 15.  3. Meaning, Man. 2, 124.  4. Purpose, Man. 4, 234; in-tention, Vikr. d. 102 (Sch.).  5. Mind, Pañc. i. d. 317; heart, Rām. 3, 24, 11; Chr. 18, 35.  6. Emotion, passion, as an object of poetry, Daśak. in Chr. 190, 11; (of music? Pañc. v. d. 44); love, Vikr. d. 72; Lass. 58, 16 (read हुर्वन्त्या भाव°).  7. Gesture.  8. Corporeal expression of amorous senti-ments.  9. A being.  10. Substance, Bhāṣāp. 13; thing, object, Utt. Rāmac. 74, 9.  11. The world.  12. Su-perhuman power.  13. The Supreme Being, Man. 4, 234.  14. A learned man.  15. Venerable, master, Vikr. 3, 11.  -- Comp. अ-, m. 1. absence, Man. 8, 259; Hit. i. d. 118, M.M. 2. non-existence; अभाव + तस्, adv. in con-sequence of the non-existence, Bhāṣāp. 113. 3. death, Kathās. 18, 270. 4. destruction, Rām. 5, 27, 6. अ-बध्य-, adj. state of being inviolable, Hit. iii. d. 63. आधार-आ-धेय- (vb. धा), m. state or relation of the receptacle and the object received, Hit. iii. d. 12 (instr. because it [viz. the mirror] can receive [reflect] only in proportion to its great-ness). आर्य-, m. honest behaviour, Rām. 1, 1, 35. एक-,  I. m. 1. same state, Hit. ii. d. 151. 2. simplicity (op-posite to duplicity), candour, Pañc. iii. d. 61. II. m. a bullock. बाल-, m. youth, Pañc. 182, 12, वृद्ध-, m. old age, Pañc. 50, 8. सद्भाव, i. e. सन्त्-, m. 1. the property of being, entity. 2. truth, Lass. 57, 7. 3. the property of goodness, kindness, Megh. 18, n. 4. honesty, Hit. iv. d. 103. 5. merit, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1880; a pure or holy disposition. 6. amiability. सर्व-, m. one's whole being, Hit. ii. d. 33. साधु-, m. goodness, Brāhmaṇav. 1, 4. स्व-, m. 1. nature, natural dispo-sition, Rām. 3, 51, 33; Hit. i. d. 19, M.M. 2. purpose, Johns. Sel. 46, 76, स्त्री-स्व-, m. 1. female nature. 2. an eunuch, attendant on women. स्था-यिघ्°, i. e. स्थायिन्-, m. 1. fixed con-dition. 2. A passion or feeling, as object of poetical description, viz. desire, mirth, etc.

भावत्क: भावत्क भावत्क, i. e. भवन्त् + क, adj., f. की, Thine.

Decorating with flowers, etc.  -- Comp. न्यग्भावन, i. e. न्यञ्च्-, n. 1. contempt. 2. humbling. विशेष-, f. reflecting on, or perceiving, differ-ences.
भावित्र: भावित्र भावित्र (vb. भू), n. The universe.
